presentation.speaker: ken
presentation.title: Supply shock: your plan
lines: Ken again. Here are your options, straight.
Prices are up and lead times are longer until the ports clear. Nobody knows how long.

choices.label: Sign a 60-day supply agreement with {supplier} ($600 fee)
choices.detail: {supplier} drops the shock surcharge for 60 days. Costs $600 up front.
choices.outcome: Ken: "Done. Sixty days of sane prices. Use them."

choices.label: Add a local backup: Aurelia Makers Co-op
choices.detail: Made in the city, so no port and no surcharge: pricier per unit, but one-day delivery. Shows up in Company OS → Operations.
choices.outcome: Ken: "No hard feelings. Tell them I sent you."

choices.label: Stock up now: {moq} more {product}
choices.detail: Spend {moq_cost} before prices climb further. Your cash goes into boxes.
choices.outcome: Ken: "On the next truck. Let's hope it's a short queue."
